_readme: Optional per-ticker settings for scripts/update_companies.py. Every EQUITY ticker used in a post is tracked automatically; add a ticker here to track it without a post, to set its sector (bio | quantum), or to give the exact lead-sponsor name used on ClinicalTrials.gov (ct_sponsor) so its trials are followed. _directory is the public coverage list on /hr/tvrtke/ and /en/companies/ (order is the order on the page). IonQ is a large-cap comparable in the Infleqtion piece: it stays in the filing tracker and off _directory.
